_comment: Deterministic, windowed rules for the Variable Watcher. Separate from svd/rules.json (instantaneous register state) on purpose — see CLAUDE.md.
_note_disabled: Rules with "enabled": false are parsed but never evaluated. Both stackWatermark rules were disabled until 2026-09-09 because RegionScan items were never sampled (WatchSampler had no byte-scan decode step) - fixed then (WatchSampler::decodeRegionScan + Backend::applyWatchPresets no longer skips RegionScan suggestions), so both are enabled again. If a future change ever makes RegionScan sampling unavailable again, disable these the same way rather than letting them promise a detection that can't happen.
